name: Riyadh
short_description: The beating heart of the Kingdom, where Najdi heritage meets modern skyscrapers.
full_description: Riyadh is the capital of Saudi Arabia, blending modern urban development with rich cultural and historical sites. It offers a unique experience for luxury lovers, desert explorers, and mountain adventurers.

shopping.name: Riyadh Park
shopping.experience_summary: A premier luxury mall with a stunning outdoor plaza and international brands.
shopping.signature_dish: The legendary fresh Honey Butter Rolls
shopping.local_tip: Parking can be crowded on weekends, try to arrive before 4 PM.

shopping.name: Nakheel Mall
shopping.experience_summary: One of Riyadh's most elegant malls with premium brands and a sophisticated atmosphere.
shopping.local_tip: Perfect for a quiet, high-end shopping experience away from the noise.

shopping.name: Granada Mall
shopping.experience_summary: A huge shopping complex with a unique architectural ceiling and a massive expansion.
shopping.top_activity: Walk through the newly expanded 'Granada Square'
shopping.local_tip: The new outdoor square has the best atmosphere for coffee and people-watching.

nature_and_adventure.name: Wadi Namar
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: A peaceful valley with a large industrial lake and waterfall.
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Great for families; bring your own chairs for a better seating spot near the lake.

nature_and_adventure.name: Al-Watan Park
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: A landmark park featuring a large map of Saudi Arabia and the Riyadh Water Tower.
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Take a photo with the iconic Water Tower
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Check if the tower is open for a panoramic view of old Riyadh.

nature_and_adventure.name: Hit Cave (Ain Heet)
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: An adventurous underground lake inside a limestone cave.
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Swimming in the clear turquoise cave water
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Wear sturdy hiking shoes; the descent into the cave is slippery.

nature_and_adventure.name: Edge of the World (Jabal Tuwaiq)
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: Breathtaking cliffs with an endless view of the desert horizon.
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Hiking to the highest cliff point
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Safety first: You MUST go in a 4x4 vehicle and leave the area before sunset.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Masmak Fort
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: The historical clay fortress that marks the start of the modern Saudi state.
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: Don't miss the incense (Oud) smells at Souq Al-Zal next door.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Al-Faisaliah Tower
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: One of Riyadh's first skyscrapers with a distinctive golden globe.
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: Booking in advance is a must for the restaurants at the top.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Kingdom Center
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: The most famous landmark in Riyadh with a unique 'bottle opener' shape.
heritage_and_landmarks.top_activity: Walk on the Sky Bridge at night
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: Go on a clear night for the best view of the city lights.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Boulevard City
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: The largest entertainment complex featuring international zones and shows.
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: Check the 'Webook' app for entry tickets; some zones are free during certain seasons.

travel_tips: Visit during Riyadh Season (Winter) for world-class events and festivals.
Explore historic districts like Al-Masmak for cultural insight.
Use ride-hailing apps like Uber or Careem to navigate traffic.
Book luxury restaurants in advance using 'MyTable' or 'TheFork' apps.
